overloadPatches.semanticRole: Displays the hierarchical pop-up menu referenced by menu (created via Create menu) at the mouse location or at (xCoord, yCoord) if given, optionally pre-selecting the item associated with the default parameter, and returns the parameter string of the item chosen.

jointConstraints.rule: xCoord and yCoord must be passed together; if only one is passed it is effectively ignored and the menu is shown at the mouse location.

constraints: menu must be a reference returned by Create menu, not a plain text menu (use Pop up menu for text-based pop-up menus).
default identifies an item by the custom string previously assigned via SET MENU ITEM PARAMETER; only a top-level item can be selected by default. If omitted, the first item is selected by default.
Should generally be called in response to a right mouse click or a mouse-down-and-hold, per standard context-menu interface conventions.
